events.title: Horizon Festival: Hinterland Arts Trail Weekend
events.description: Part of the Sunshine Coast’s not‑for‑profit multi-site arts festival, this self-guided trail weekend opens local artist studios and small galleries in the hinterland with talks, demonstrations and intimate exhibition spaces.

events.title: Life Drawing at The MET
events.location: The MET (Maroochy Events Centre arts space), Maroochydore
events.description: Evening untutored life drawing session in a boutique arts space with professional model, easels and basic materials provided; a relaxed environment popular with local artists and TAFE/uni students.

events.title: University of the Sunshine Coast Research & Ideas Public Lecture
events.location: UniSC Innovation Centre Lecture Theatre, Sippy Downs
events.description: Free community talk from UniSC academics as part of the Research & Ideas public lecture series, covering current regional issues and inviting community Q&A; open to the public with registration required.

events.title: Alpha Fest – The Mateship Muster
events.location: Sandstone Point Hotel, Sandstone Point (near Sunshine Coast)
events.description: Boutique one-day mateship-themed festival at the waterfront Sandstone Point Hotel featuring Australian live acts, food stalls and social activities focused on camaraderie and connection.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast – Final May Weekend
events.location: Various private studios & small galleries, Sunshine Coast Hinterland & Coastal suburbs
events.description: Region-wide open studios program where painters, ceramicists, printmakers and sculptors open their working spaces to the public for tours, sales and conversations on the final May weekend.

events.title: Maleny Lane World Food & Music Night
events.description: Laneway-style evening with global street food vendors, bar and intimate live music from local acts in a small community courtyard setting; a regular Maleny social scene.

events.title: Sunshine Coast Hinterland Craft Beer Festival 2026
events.description: Local craft beer celebration in the Sunshine Coast Hinterland with small-batch breweries, tasting paddles, live music and food vendors across central Maleny venues; community-focused with a relaxed social atmosphere.

events.title: Sunday Sessions Live Music on the Deck
events.description: Weekly waterfront Sunday arvo session featuring rotating local acoustic and roots musicians on the outdoor deck, with casual bar bites and cocktails; attracts a regular local crowd.
